feedback_driven.quote: Sales, customer service, and support teams began managing their own prompts, with continuous incremental improvements based on feedback from daily use.

persists_across_tasks.quote: Results were good, but the group saw value in continuous iteration: optimizing prompts every day and running A/B tests between approaches.

data.why_zh: 业务团队基于日常反馈持续迭代并A/B测试提示，不训练模型权重，提示作为可复用工件演化。
